scopeNote: Firebase-internal underscore plumbing is private and excluded from public coverage by rule. Public gaps include bundle-loading, cache index-tuning knobs, and exported types that are not yet mirrored.

dispositions.reason: Index-tuning / GC-policy APIs have no real knob to turn in an in-memory sandbox today, but sibling cache-factory tokens are already honest inert tokens; these are buildable the same way and not genuinely out of scope.
Bundle-loading depends on a protobuf packaging format not modeled in the sandbox yet — a data/parsing problem, not external infrastructure, so it is buildable rather than genuinely un-modelable.
